implementation.name: original-v2-traditional-vs-ml-fleet
implementation.scope: Separate original map-task and synchronous-training examples; retained outputs and barrier dependencies.
implementation.question: Why can one task retry alone while a shared update waits?

purpose: Show retained independent outputs versus a shared model version gated on every gradient and the collective.
storyboard: Map2 completes independently; both outputs persist.
Inspect completion of Map 3’s isolated retry, which overlaps peers on the original timeline; then reduce all required outputs.
Healthy training workers finish local gradients but retain model v.
Late gradient arrives; AllReduce finishes and returns same result.
Only then update every replica to v+1.
guard: Outputs O1/O2 survive retry; reducer requires all inputs; all local gradients before collective completion; no shared update early; no scalar optimizer toy or timing claim. Completion snapshots do not serialize retry launch after other maps.
